name: theme-toggle
title: ThemeToggle
description: Icon button that switches between the dark (Deep Ink) and light (Paper) themes and remembers the choice.

keyboard: Toggles the light theme on or off
aria: The label stays "Light theme"; aria-pressed="true" means the light theme is active
Preference is stored under localStorage key microcks-theme and applied as data-theme on <html>
A microcks-theme-change event is dispatched on document
a11y.notes: Call restoreTheme() before first paint where possible (inline script) to avoid a flash. Storage failures are ignored.
